title: Schools that turn off Google's AI will lose search too starting in 2027
summary_raw: Starting in 2027, Google plans to turn off AI features in its school products by default, letting schools decide what to enable. The catch: schools that block AI entirely on their devices will also lose access to Google Search, since the two systems are now too deeply intertwined to separate. Given Google's grip on the US school market, that "choice" doesn't leave schools with much room to maneuver. The article Schools that turn off Google's AI will lose search too starting in 2027 appeared first on The Decoder .

title: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week
summary_raw: OpenAI's hardware team used GPT-6 Astra to design a device for the Codex coding agent in under a week, handling everything from the enclosure to the circuit board to the firmware. Several revision rounds were needed before production because the model didn't always account for manufacturing tolerances. A newer internal model scores significantly higher on OpenAI's engineering benchmark, though the company isn't sharing details. title: Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
summary_raw: Stanford researchers tested 50 widely cited claims about LLMs against 20 current models. 44 percent of the findings are already "expired," and another 34 percent have weakened significantly. The average lifespan is just 15.7 months. Claims about what models can't do expire fastest. The article Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .

title: AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence
summary_raw: The SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen are now using AI agents at the Allen Telescope Array to control the telescope and analyze incoming radio signals. Tasks that used to take weeks can now wrap up in hours, and the team says the system detected a pulsar in the Crab Nebula in real time for the first time.
